description: Search tasks across the entire Workspace with filters (Spaces, Folders, Lists, statuses, assignees, tags, due dates). This is the deep search to use when you don't know which List a task is in. Paginated.

assignees.description: Only return tasks assigned to any of these user ids.

due_date_gt.description: Only tasks due AFTER this date (natural language, ISO, or epoch ms).

due_date_lt.description: Only tasks due BEFORE this date.

include_closed.description: If true, also include closed/done tasks.

list_ids.description: Restrict the search to these List ids.

page.description: 0-based page number for pagination. Defaults to 0.

project_ids.description: Restrict the search to these Folder ids (ClickUp calls Folders 'projects' here).

reverse.description: If true, reverse the sort order (descending).

space_ids.description: Restrict the search to these Space ids.

statuses.description: Only return tasks whose status name is in this list.

subtasks.description: If true, include subtasks in the results.

tags.description: Only return tasks that have all of these tag names.

team_id.description: Team/Workspace ID. Falls back to CLICKUP_TEAM_ID when omitted.

name: get_workspace_tasks
